【滙豐Premier Elite｜洞悉環球市場先機，盡佔全球財富機遇】 浩瀚世界，每個角落都蘊含無限機遇，引領你發掘更多可能性，邁向你夢寐以求嘅財富境象。 滙豐在你所在，憑藉強大環球網絡，覆蓋超過60多個國家及地區，涵蓋多元業務及市場領域，並透過以下一系列服務，為您帶來前瞻投資洞見，助您迅速洞悉獨家全球市投資機遇： 📌首席投資總監專家觀點 📌Think Wealth系列 📌財富滙談 加上「滙圖多元貨幣保險計劃II」^，支援多達10種貨幣選擇*，靈活應對您唔同階段嘅全球財富目標。 每步未來，財富成就所在。 新一年，準備好展開專屬於你嘅財富新境象？立即晉身滙豐Premier Elite並登記「理財尊尚選」，尊享總值超過港幣88,000元迎新及財富產品獎賞：https://grp.hsbc/26CC3YTOPV3T ^「滙圖多元貨幣保險計劃 II 」是具備儲蓄成分及非保證回報的人壽保險計劃，並非等同銀行存款計劃。 *「澳門幣」僅適用於澳門簽發的保單，實際供應視乎滙豐保險決定。 投資涉及風險。優惠受條款及細則約束。 本資訊旨在提供予香港境內人士。 【HSBC Premier Elite｜Act First on Global Market Opportunities】 Opportunities are everywhere — just take the leap to seize them and create your future. Wherever your ambition leads, we’re there. Drawing on a network that spans 60+ countries and regions, HSBC delivers the reach and market expertise to support your ambitions. Explore a series of solutions designed to open doors to global investment opportunities: 📌Insights from our Chief Investment Office 📌Think Wealth Series 📌Wealth Studio Also aiding your ambition beyond borders is the HSBC Eminent Goal Multi-Currency Insurance Plan II^, which adapts to your evolving needs at different stages of wealth by supporting 10 currency exchange options*. Wealth. Growth into future stages. Are you ready to embark on a wealth journey designed exclusively for you? Join HSBC Premier Elite & register for Wealth of Your Choice to enjoy wealth management & welcome rewards worth over HKD88,000: https://grp.hsbc/26CC3YTOPV3E ^HSBC Eminent Goal Multi-Currency Insurance Plan II is a long-term participating life insurance plan with a savings element and non-guaranteed returns. It is not equivalent or similar to a bank deposit. *MOP is to be made available for the policies issued in Macau only, exact availability to be determined by us. Investment involves risks. T&Cs apply. The info and offer are intended for persons in HK only.
HSBC Hong Kong
